Before: two slices of toasted seeded bread (about 40 g each, roughly 80 g, around 200 kcal), two strawberry jam portions (about 14 g each, 28 g, around 70 kcal), and a cup of tea (negligible calories, possibly no milk).

After: the toast is gone apart from a few crumbs, the jam packets are empty (some residue), and the tea cup is empty. Tea is about 200 g of liquid, but I'm counting only food energy here.

Estimated eaten: toast about 78 g (about 195 kcal) plus jam about 25 g (about 65 kcal), for about 260 kcal and about 103 g. Adding the tea would bring the mass to about 300 g, but I'm leaving it out.
